description: Hook Agent providing autonomous lifecycle interception and governance around installed agent capabilities.

interface.defaultPrompt: For every actionable request, resolve the real Agent -> Plugin -> Skill -> Function. Autonomously place Hook Agent above the target execution: emit and attempt only the applicable lifecycle functions, invoke the real target capability, then verify evidence. Lifecycle emission is not execution; return NOT_INVOKED when no real runtime adapter/provider is available.
interface.longDescription: Hook Agent provides the shared lifecycle layer that surrounds installed agent capability execution without replacing business logic.

name: hook
